title: Leverage: Redemption
description:

The team picks the brain of a legendary grifter and tries to find the loot from her best con before her abusive guardian does.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:

An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E16 — Last Gasp
The BAU meets in secret to investigate a subject who appears to be kidnapping and photographing young women.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E17 — The Capilanos
The BAU is called to Oklahoma to investigate a murderous clown who is terrorizing a town.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E18 — The Dance of Love
The BAU travels to Chicago to investigate a case where red roses are left on victims; Rossi gets an unexpected visit from his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E19 — Ex Parte
The BAU takes charge of a hostage situation at a law firm where Matt Simmons' wife works.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E20 — All You Can Eat
The BAU is called upon when bioterrorism is suspected in a series of mysterious deaths; Garcia visits her stepbrother to take care of a difficult family issue.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E21 — Mixed Signals
The BAU is called to Taos, N.M., when someone targets victims' temporal lobes.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E22 — Believer
The team questions the credibility of a former FBI agent's bizarre account.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E01 — 300
When Reid and Garcia are abducted by a mass murderer, it's up to the rest of the team to find them; the BAU looks to their past to solve why the two heroes have been targeted.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E02 — Starter Home
The team tracks a serial killer when remains of numerous victims are found in the walls of an elderly couple's home; the hunt becomes urgent after the BAU learns the killer's specific ritual of when to strike; Rossi reconnects with his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E03 — Rule 34
Packages with gruesome contents are delivered to six people in the Washington, D.C. area; Simmons and Kristy struggle to connect with their son, David, who is suspended from school for aggressive behavior.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E04 — Innocence
Soon after the BAU steps in to help local law enforcement isolate a suspect for a murder, a second person who is related to the first victim is killed under similar circumstances; Prentiss is concerned about Garcia's behavior.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E05 — The Tall Man
The BAU investigates a spooky local ghost story of the "Tall Man" and the clues it provides when two people go missing in the woods; a third person mysteriously surfaces the following day with limited details as to what happened to her friends.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E06 — Luke
The BAU investigates four murders along the eastern seaboard; the crimes become personal for Alvez when the team discovers there are ties to his time spent in pursuit of a notorious hit man; Alvez and his girlfriend decide to move in together.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E07 — Twenty Seven
The BAU races to capture the vigilantes behind a series of attacks taking place every 27 minutes in the nation's capital; Prentiss and Unit Chief Andrew Mendoza lead the effort to identify the vigilantes and what's motivating them.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E08 — Ashley
The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire; Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall don't go as planned.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E09 — Broken Wing
A professor from Lewis' past tips off the BAU to an alarming number of overdose deaths of patients who just completed rehab.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E10 — Flesh and Blood
Prentiss faces her past when the BAU is sent to investigate the murders of prominent businessmen, all of whom are missing their hearts; Prentiss plans a romantic first date with Mendoza, but the evening is cut short by an urgent call from Rossi.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E11 — Night Lights
The BAU team heads to Portland, Ore., to investigate a chilling abduction that may be linked to a local couple who were killed in their home a week earlier.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E12 — Hamelin
The BAU team flies to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes, with surveillance video from a park as their only lead to finding the children's whereabouts.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E13 — Chameleon
Rossi questions his actions in the aftermath of a struggle with a serial killer who appears to have outsmarted the BAU.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E02 — Bravo Lead + Loyalty + Friendship
Jack receives an emergency distress signal from one of his old Delta buddies who has been accused of terrorism in a foreign country; MacGyver and Jack quickly recruit the rest of Jack's old Delta team and stage an unsanctioned rescue operation.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E03 — Bozer + Booze + Back to School
MacGyver and the team go undercover on a college campus to find an operative who is recruiting students to carry out deadly attacks; Jack joins bounty hunter Billy Colton in the hunt for a bail jumper.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E04 — Guts + Fuel + Hope
MacGyver and Riley must find a way to drive a tanker filled with liquid oxygen through a region occupied by rebels and deliver it to a children's hospital; Riley helps MacGyver decide whether to allow his father back into his life.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E05 — Dia de Muertos + Sicarios + Family
Mac and Jack rush to Mexico to help capture the leader of a drug cartel while the country celebrates Día de Muertos.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E06 — Murdoc + MacGyver + Murdoc
Murdoc abducts MacGyver's girlfriend to force Mac to help him rescue his son from a kidnapper; a dangerous person from Murdoc's personal life shows up, giving Mac a glimpse into the villain's past.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E07 — Scavengers + Hard Drive + Dragonfly
Matty sends the team to Ghana to recover a hard drive from an e-waste landfill that is run by a powerful and violent man, leading them to speculate about what could be on the device.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E08 — Revenge + Catacombs + Le Fantome
An Irish military intelligence officer claims to know the whereabouts of a lethal bomb maker whom Mac has been hunting for years.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E09 — Specimen 234 + PAPR + Outbreak
When a vial containing a deadly virus is stolen from the Center for Disease Control in Atlanta, MacGyver and team race to recover it before the thief unleashes a global pandemic.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E13 — The Daredevil in the Mold
The team analyzes a BMX rider's remains, discovered on the roof of a warehouse; Sweets asks Booth for advice; Booth makes a decision about Hannah.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E14 — The Bikini in the Soup
When the liquefied remains of a wedding planner are found in a tanning bed on Valentine's Day, Cam pressures the team to work fast so she can spend the holiday with her boyfriend; Clark helps Hodgins realize the best gifts come from the heart.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E15 — The Killer in the Crosshairs
Sniper Jacob Broadsky takes out a victim who escaped from the justice system; Booth uses his military training to try to stop Broadsky before he strikes again; Angela's father visits the Jeffersonian.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E16 — The Blackout in the Blizzard
During a blizzard that causes a citywide blackout, the team must solve a murder case that could be connected to a possible viral outbreak; Sweets starts a touchy conversation about Brennan and Booth's relationship.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E17 — The Feet on the Beach
Brennan teams up with a forensic podiatrist to match seven pairs of severed feet with bodies that wash ashore after a flood; Cam makes college plans for her daughter behind her back.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E18 — The Truth in the Myth
A TV-show host's remains are found in the wilderness; Vincent Nigel-Murray makes surprising confessions while making amends with each member of the team.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E19 — Finder
The remains of a maritime museum security guard are found in the Florida Everglades after an attempt to steal a 17th century nautical chart to find treasures; Booth asks a former Iraqi soldier for help with the case.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E20 — The Pinocchio in the Planter
The remains of a successful ad man are found in a new community center playground; the members of the team try to communicate more honestly.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E21 — The Signs in the Silence
An unidentified 15-year-old girl, who is hearing impaired and not able to communicate, is found covered in blood and wielding a knife; Angela hides the details of her pregnancy.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E22 — The Hole in the Heart
Booth becomes more determined to catch Jacob Broadsky after he takes out another victim.

title: Bones
description:
S06 E23 — The Change in the Game
Booth and Brennan go undercover to find out what happened to a man whose remains were found lodged in the pinsetter at a bowling lane.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E01 — The Memories in the Shallow Grave
A woman's remains are found in a paintball field; Booth and Brennan adjust to life as an expectant couple.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E02 — The Hot Dog in the Competition
The team identifies the remains of a competitive-eating champion just days before a contest; a brilliant new squint has trouble fitting in; Booth and Brennan try to put themselves in each other's places after a disagreement about the baby.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E03 — The Prince in the Plastic
Booth and Sweets are given access to a toy company's headquarters after an executive's remains are found packaged with a Prince Charming doll; Sweets prepares for his gun certification test; Brennan worries about motherhood.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E04 — The Male in the Mail
After dismembered remains are found in multiple mailing boxes, the team uncovers a complicated love triangle; Booth's grandfather reveals surprising news; Special Agent Genny Shaw (Tina Majorino) learns how important teamwork is.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E05 — The Twist in the Twister
The team suspects murder when a storm chaser is killed while filming a tornado; Booth becomes increasingly protective of Brennan.

title: NCIS: New Orleans

The NCIS team investigates when a Marine corporal who is an amateur race car driver is in a fatal crash on the track.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:

Pride needs to protect a family friend engaged to the prime suspect in an ongoing NCIS and FBI cartel case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E11 — Let It Ride
Sebastian goes undercover; Patton practices his old gambling skills; Pride and the team embark on a perilous plan to trap Garcia.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E12 — Hell on the High Water
After Pride travels to a deep-sea oil rig for a murder investigation, the team uncovers a gas leak that's on the verge of causing a catastrophic explosion; Sebastian starts his NCIS special agent training.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E13 — Return of the King
After thousands of classified government files are stolen, the NCIS team searches for an underground group of hackers who were co-founded by Elvis Bertrand, Pride's old contact.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E14 — Pandora's Box, Part II
NCIS agents McGee and Torres head to New Orleans to partner with Pride and his team in the search for the missing homeland security theoretical terror playbook.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E15 — End of the Line
Painful memories come flooding back when a gruesome copycat murder leads to the reopening of a case for Wade.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E16 — The Last Stand
Pride's longtime friend, state and military attorney Rita Devereaux, asks NCIS to investigate the disappearance of a JAG lawyer who specializes in classified cases and volunteers at a private military academy.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E04 — Mea Makamae
The team investigates the murder of a deep-sea diver famous for the valuable treasure he finds.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E05 — Ma'ema'e
The team's investigation into a volleyball coach's murder reveals more bad news about Kono; Chin Ho reconnects with his ex-fiancée.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E06 — Ka Hakaka Maika'i
McGarrett takes part in a charity MMA fight while investigating a wealthy restaurateur's murder; NCIS Agent Kensi Blye examines a video of McGarrett's father.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E07 — Ka Iwi Kapu
Two young people filming a documentary about a Hawaiian burial site are murdered; during the investigation, a drifter (Robert Englund) puts a curse on Danny.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E08 — Lapa'au
The investigation into a plane crash reveals the customs agent on board was dead before takeoff; Danny cares for an orphaned dog.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E09 — Ike Maka
The physically altered corpse of an unidentified man is found in the trunk of a stolen car; Danno crashes on McGarrett's couch.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E10 — Ki'ilua
McGarrett travels to North Korea with Jenna Kaye to deliver ransom to rebels holding her fiancé hostage; the team investigates the murder of an investigative reporter who appears to have connections to Jenna.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E11 — Pahele
McGarrett and the team search for a missing bus full of school children and those responsible for the crime.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E12 — Alaheo Pau'ole
On the night before Chin Ho's wedding, the team's investigation into a man left to die in an abandoned bunker intersects with Capt. Fryer's case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E13 — Ka Ho'oponopono
When a teenager is murdered, the team must determine why she was targeted and if the person responsible was a hired professional.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E14 — Pu'olo
Chin Ho shares news about Joe White that rocks McGarrett to his core; Danny is forced to play midwife when his ex goes into early labor.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E15 — Mai Ka Wa Kahiko
When Danno and his family are targeted by a vengeful dirty cop from Danno's past, the team steps in to help.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E16 — I Helu Pu
When the team almost causes an international incident, Lt. Gov. Denning decides that one of them should be fired; Chin Ho faces the harrowing task of choosing a Valentine's Day gift for Malia.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E17 — Kupale
The team investigates when a man dressed as a Hawaiian NaKoa warrior is found dead near the site of a war re-enactment.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E18 — Lekio
The team crosses paths with a retired NYPD bomb expert while investigating the death of a famous talk-radio host.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E19 — Kalele
When McGarrett's sister is arrested for smuggling diamonds, he enlists the help of an ex-con to set up a sting.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E01 — Blast From the Past
Toby and Michelle investigate a string of high-tech thefts in Vancouver.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E02 — The Blue Line
Toby and Michelle search for a dangerous gang while feeling the pressure of the new police superintendent.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E03 — Early Checkout
When Tia's colleague is targeted by a hotel owner, Toby pushes for an investigation.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E04 — Cold Storage
Toby and Michelle search for a killer suspected of taking national defense secrets.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E15 — Le Carnivale de la Mort
A petty officer is murdered during Mardi Gras festivities; Pride contemplates what to tell his daughter about his strained relationship with his father.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E16 — My Brother's Keeper
The NCIS team tries to narrow down the motive when a Navy recruiter is murdered in a hit-and-run; LaSalle worries about his brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E17 — More Now
Pride believes Baitfish has returned and has the NCIS team chase down leads in an attempt to locate him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E18 — The List
When a sailor is killed in a strip club, the murder weapon turns out to be linked to other unsolved cases; Brody receives a visit from her ex-fiance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E19 — The Insider
During the autopsy of a petty officer who seems to have died of natural causes, an armed man holds Wade, Sebastian and Danny hostage in the morgue.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E20 — Rock-a-Bye-Baby
When a Navy commander's car is stolen with his baby inside, the team must determine if it was a targeted abduction.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E21 — You'll Do
LaSalle's brother, Cade, needs the team's help when he becomes a murder suspect -- and cannot remember what happened; LaSalle is determined to prove Cade's innocence, despite the wealth of evidence against him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E22 — How Much Pain Can You Take?
Baitfish murders a person close to the team in order to send a message to Pride; a citywide hunt for the elusive criminal takes place.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E23 — My City
Pride has suspicions about a mole; new intelligence comes to light that indicates a breach at the ports.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E01 — Sic Semper Tyranis
Pride and the team must go on a dangerous undercover mission to retrieve a stolen missile and prevent an attack.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E02 — Shadow Unit
A blogger dedicated to exposing government corruption is murdered; during the investigation, it is revealed that a war crime may have occurred during a humanitarian effort in Bolivia.
